## Overview

LRPITT14B is the **unadjusted available-case modified ITT** analysis for letter-sound knowledge (YARC-LSK) (`yarclet`) on the **SES complete-case subset**—the matched comparator to LRPITT13b. It adjusts for no SES covariates but deliberately restricts to the same rows (`restrict_complete`): LRPITT13b versus LRPITT14B isolates adjustment with the selected sample fixed, while comparison with LRPITT07 isolates the additional complete-case selection. The estimand is the assigned-arm contrast in $L_{\text{post}}$ in that SES-complete fitted sample. A causal reading requires the archive, outcome and SES complete-case selection not to induce an association between assigned arm and potential outcomes; extending the result to all 57 randomised children requires further missing-data assumptions and sensitivity.

_Identification and sign convention._ Under the locked causal DAG, $G$ is a randomised root, so the offer contrast in the original full randomised cohort requires no baseline-covariate adjustment. Restricting to archived children with observed outcome and SES variables can break that exchangeability; a causal reading of $\tau$ in this complete-case sample requires that selection did not induce an association between assigned arm and potential outcomes, while extension to all 57 requires further missing-data assumptions and sensitivity. The own baseline and linear age are **precision terms only** — they may sharpen $\tau$ but do not identify effects after selection. **Sign convention:** $G = 1$ is the intervention arm, so a **positive** $\tau$ means the intervention arm has the higher modelled outcome.

## Model

$$
\eta_i = \alpha + \tau\, G_i
       + \gamma_{\text{own}}\, \text{logit}_*(L_{\mathrm{pre},i}, N)
       + \gamma_A\, A_{\text{std},i},
$$

with Beta-Binomial likelihood $L_{\text{post},i} \sim \text{BetaBinomial}(N, \mu_i\kappa, (1-\mu_i)\kappa)$,
$\mu_i = \sigma(\eta_i)$, $N = 32$. Priors follow the shared template in `priors.py`.
No covariate adjustment; the fit is restricted to the SES complete-case rows. HSGPs are off by default.
